thread:
alisha: hey team, quick last-minute thing — flight just rebooked, need to bounce at 21:30. can someone take primary for the night window (22:00-06:00)? i can shadow until 22:30 to warm up. :airplane:

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager policy triggered for service=embed-cache at 20:47 — threshold 5/min exceeded. No active incidents.

morgan: i can take primary from 22:00 until 02:00. happy to own escalations and paging. please ping me if there are any ongoing noisy routes. @alisha want me to claim now? :thumbsup:

alisha: @morgan yes please claim now. i'll DM the customer-facing notes and the small runbook tweaks i did earlier. thanks so much. :pray:

devon: i can shadow from 22:00-03:00 and take over if you need to hand off early. will keep an eye on the embed-cache alerts.

nina: quick checklist for whoever's primary:
- confirm rotation claim in PagerDuty
- point to runbook snippet below for noisy embed-cache route
- set temp suppression on non-critical alerts if noise persists
- run the healthcheck after any restart: /ops/healthcheck

runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/oncall/embed-cache-noise

runbook excerpt:
```
# embed-cache noisy-route mitigation
1) identify top noisy key: redis-cli --csv "HGETALL noisy_keys" | sort -k2 -nr | head -n30
2) disable the cache proxy route: curl -X POST https://infra-api/services/embed-cache/route/disable -d '{"route":"/v1/embeds/bulk"}'
3) restart proxy (graceful): kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-cache-proxy -n prod --timeout=5m
4) verify via logs: kubectl logs -l app=embed-cache-proxy -n prod --since=5m | tail -n 200
5) if CPU drops and errors stop, re-enable route after 10m
```

morgan: noted. i'll claim in PD and add a short note: 'Primary oncall — morgan — 22:00-02:00 (shadow devon until 03:00)'. will also mute the low-priority alert channel if it keeps firing.

alisha: fyi i set a small canary rollout on the embed-cache proxy earlier (10% traffic) — i left the link in the DM to @morgan. if you see elevated 5xxs it's probably that.

devon: thanks. if the 5xx spike shows up, prefer rollback to full restart. i'll be on standby to run the rollback command.

incident-bot: Note: an automated mitigation was attempted at 20:55 for embed-cache route but failed (timeout). See logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/abc123

nina: extra pointer — if you take the rollback path, use the safe flag in the deploy CLI: `redeploy --service embed-cache --to stable --safe=true` and watch for the monotonic latency metric for 10m.

morgan: claimed in PD, note added, will mute channel if noise persists. @devon can you watch latency dashboards and call me if p99 goes above 800ms? i'll handle pager escalations.

alisha: thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick cover. i'll hand over the customer note (short summary + who to escalate to) in the incident channel before i go. :heart:

devon: copy. i've got dashboard alerts bookmarked. will post any findings to this thread and the incident channel.

nina: putting final runbook snippets into the runbooks link now, added the rollback play.

morgan: all set from my side. ping me if you need a handoff earlier than 02:00. enjoy the flight @alisha :flight_departure:
